name: An Thuong
summary: The streets just inland from My Khe, full of bars and kitchens you can walk between. This is the night that belongs with a beach hotel. Kalà Kalà, on the sand at 51 Vo Nguyen Giap, is the beach club, and entry is free. East West is the brewery taproom facing the water, open 08:00 to 01:00. Those two orient the evening. This is not a bar list.
fee: Check on arrival. Kalà Kalà publishes free entry. A drink is not a city ticket.
getThere: Walk west from a My Khe hotel, a few streets inland from the sand. A short Grab from the river.
